label: Excellent
corporate_parent: BSH Home Appliances Corporation — subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH

burner_system.description: Patented Star Burner with 5-arm flame geometry. Raised pedestal base for easier cleaning. Designed for better flame distribution and reduced cold spots.
burner_system.extra_low_simmer: ExtraLow feature cycles gas burner on/off to maintain very low temps (~100°F). Not a true continuous-flame simmer like Wolf 500 BTU.
burner_system.supplier: BSH-designed. Valve components likely Copreci (Spanish OEM partner to BSH).

grate_system.description: Continuous heavy cast iron grates — consistent with pro-style standard

construction.source_traceability: Multi-source — BSH operates factories across multiple countries

oven_convection.system_name: True Convection — third-element convection with dedicated heating element and fan
oven_convection.steam_assist: Steam assist functionality injects steam during traditional cooking modes (Bake, Roast, Convection). Locks in moisture for meats and bread. Genuine steam injection via reservoir, not just humidity venting.

broiler.description: Standard gas broiler — not infrared (unlike Wolf and BlueStar)

performance_evidence.simmer_method: ExtraLow cycling (not continuous flame like Wolf)
performance_evidence.simmer_min_temp: ~100°F via cycling — effective but not precision continuous simmer
performance_evidence.oven_temp_uniformity: 6-10°F estimated — true convection single fan is competitive but below dual-fan systems
performance_evidence.boil_time: good — 18K BTU is standard premium tier
performance_evidence.broiler_performance: Gas standard — lacks Wolf/BlueStar infrared advantage
performance_evidence.steam_assist: Genuine differentiator for bread baking and roasting — moisture retention

yale_service_rate.gas_range_data: Thermador NOT specifically listed in Yale gas range data. Yale induction data: Thermador 4.9%.
yale_service_rate.brand_context: BSH brands generally show strong reliability. Bosch induction 1.7% is best in category.

igniter_type.description: Spark ignition for surface burners. Hot-surface igniter for oven. Standard BSH components.
igniter_type.common_issues: Moisture, debris, or dirty igniter can cause continuous clicking — common service call

service_network.description: BSH parts widely stocked across national distribution. Factory-authorized service available through BSH network.

parts_availability.description: BSH parts universally available through independent and authorized distributors. OEM parts searchable by E-Nr model number.

control_board.notes: BSH control boards — pattern from BSH dishwasher category noted relay concerns. Not confirmed for gas range ERC specifically.

safety_evidence.recalls: None identified for current Thermador Pro Grand models
safety_evidence.gas_emissions: NO₂ non-differentiated by brand — ventilation is the intervention

platform_disclosure.bsh_shared_platform: MANDATORY: Thermador shares BSH platform with Bosch and Gaggenau. Star Burner and ExtraLow are Thermador-exclusive features, but underlying engineering DNA is shared. Thermador Pro Harmony is a lower internal tier of the same platform.
platform_disclosure.cross_category_wall_oven: INVESTIGATION NEEDED: Thermador Masterpiece wall oven was confirmed to share cavity, hinges, and self-clean system with Thermador Professional in Pass 3 research. Pro Grand range oven section likely shares components with wall oven — not confirmed at part-number level.

S: Yale Appliance (no Thermador gas range data; induction 4.9%)
